summary: Creates circular POP geometry or point data for particle and POP workflows. Useful as a simple finite emitter/source for POP chains.

key_params.name: divisions
key_params.note: Number of points or segments around the circle

key_params.name: orientation
key_params.note: Plane or orientation for the generated circle

common_gotchas: POP workflows need finite bounds validation; sample P or bounds after adding motion/noise.
Use a Null POP output so downstream references remain stable as the internal POP chain changes.
